definitions.full: H5522. Sikkuth סִכּוּת proper name, of a divinity Amos 5:26 read probably * סַכּוּת , = Assyrian Sakkut (epithet of Adar-Ninip = Saturn), Schr SK 1874, 332 ; COT AM 5, 26, compare Tiele Geschichte. 528 Bae Rel 239 Rogers Ency. Bib. 749 (Vrss Thes and others = סֻכּוֺת סֻכָּה, ).
